top_posts.author: AdamBrennan2
top_posts.text:
look how the installed base of da vinci systems at intuitive $ISRG keeps climbing, and placements of new systems are growing even faster than a year ago 
 
the newest version, da vinci 5, is leading that. procedure growth did slow though, so procedures are not keeping pace with the robots going in 
 
more robots in hospitals usually means more procedures later, so is the slowdown just a pause?

baxter $BAX screens as the cheapest name in this group of medical device makers on sales, at 1.1x against a peer median of 4.2x
